expected_diagnosis: Severe memory pressure coincides with disconnections; exact SSH impact needs validation.
resolution_guidance: Investigate job memory, set resource limits or capacity plan with owner.
verification: No OOM events during job, sessions remain stable.
escalate_when: Production outage, repeated OOM, infrastructure resource cap.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
